answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 487 Country: India Title: Can we use the interest money to clean the grave yard? Question: Can we use the interest money to clean the grave yard? Answer ID: 487 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 182/L) The interest money should be given to poor without having any intention of thawab (reward): ل أ ن سبیل الکسب الخبیث التصدق إ ذا تعذر الرد علی صاحبہ (شام ي ، 9/553 ، ط زکریا دیوبند) So, it is not permissible to use interest money to clean the graveyard. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
